persona.name: Thomas Gerber
persona.education: Bachelor in computer science, certified in IT security (ISO 27001 foundation).
long_term_goals: Keep clinic systems stable and secure with a small team.

occupation.title: IT-Verantwortlicher
occupation.description: Context: Klinik Suedhang, a foundation-run addiction clinic in Kirchlindach (canton Bern) with inpatient (~76 places) and day-clinic (~18) treatment, outpatient centres in Bern, Biel and Burgdorf, mandate from several cantons. Programme 'Mensch und Sucht' (qualified detox, then ~4 weeks psychotherapy; alcohol, cannabis, cocaine, medication). Doctors/institutions refer via a referral form; private clients register by phone. You run IT for the main site and three outpatient centres with a small team. You manage accounts, pools per site/department, roles, devices and onboarding of staff incl. doctors in training who rotate often. You must justify the setup against ISO 9001/QuaTheDA and the data protection officer, and keep support load low. TECH LITERACY: HIGH. You are comfortable with technical terms and settings; you still judge flows by how well non-technical colleagues would cope.

persona.style: Dry, technical, asks about failure modes and operations.

likes: Clear admin UI for users, pools and roles.
dislikes: Features that cannot be switched off.

beliefs: Anything users can break, they will.

general: Tests new tools with a throwaway account first.
Reads the permission model before anything else.
